packs.title: Learn Hangul
packs.description: Learn the Korean alphabet from scratch. Master vowels, consonants, pronunciation rules, and batchim so you can confidently read Korean words and sentences.

packs.title: Introducing Yourself
packs.description: Learn how to introduce yourself, talk about who you are, where you're from, and what you do using essential beginner grammar.

packs.title: Everyday Conversations
packs.description: Start building real sentences. Learn present tense verbs, talk about places, describe activities, and express what you can and can't do.

packs.title: Talking About the Past
packs.description: Learn how to talk about past experiences, ongoing actions, possessions, and everyday requests in natural Korean.

packs.title: Making Longer Sentences
packs.description: Connect ideas, compare situations, talk about abilities, express obligations, and discuss possible future situations.

packs.title: Reasons & Respectful Korean
packs.description: Explain why things happen and learn how to speak more politely and respectfully in different social situations.

packs.title: Describing Things & Future Plans
packs.description: Describe people, places, and objects more naturally while learning how to talk about future plans and expectations.

packs.title: Sharing Information
packs.description: Learn how to report what other people said, ask indirect questions, pass along suggestions, and express hopes and wishes.

packs.title: Advanced Conversation Skills
packs.description: Learn passive and causative expressions, indirect commands, and advanced patterns that help you sound more natural in conversation.

packs.title: Speaking More Naturally
packs.description: Improve your fluency with advanced honorifics, comparisons, and sentence patterns commonly used by native speakers.

packs.title: Advanced Opinions & Explanations
packs.description: Express complex reasons, expectations, assumptions, and evaluations while learning more nuanced Korean expressions.

packs.title: Natural Korean Expressions
packs.description: Master common shortcuts, conversational expressions, reflections on past events, and advanced structures used in real Korean.
